expectations.text: MD034 is correctly described as flagging bare URLs (URLs NOT wrapped in angle brackets)
expectations.evidence: MD034 flags any URL that appears 'naked' (bare) in the body of a Markdown document — meaning a raw URL written out as plain text without being wrapped in angle brackets (`<…>`) or formatted as a proper Markdown hyperlink

expectations.text: The fix described is to wrap URLs in angle brackets <> or use [text](url) format
expectations.evidence: Two fix patterns provided: Option A shows angle-bracket wrapping '<https://github.com/example/repo>' and Option B shows Markdown link format '[example repository](https://github.com/example/repo)'

expectations.text: Both URLs in the content are identified as violating MD034
expectations.evidence: Output states 'Two of the three errors are MD034 violations — one per URL' and the table shows both URLs on lines 1 and 3 as bare URLs with plain text, no wrapping/syntax
